matching_rules.exact_name_match: AxData RequestField.name equals project registry code/full path/leaf or canonical name (case-sensitive); identity is source + full path.
matching_rules.same_family_match: Only registry rows whose source_lineage.independence_family exactly equals AxData source_code are counted. This does not assert semantic or unit equivalence.
matching_rules.aggregate_match: market_sources rows are reported separately when source_lineage has no confirmed family; they are not counted as CLS/KPH same-family evidence.
matching_rules.any_family_match: Exact code/path/canonical name match against any registry source; this is a lexical hit, not source equivalence.
matching_rules.collector_mapping: Family-level candidates, project helper counterparts, and literal AxData invocations are separate. Family overlap alone never proves endpoint replacement.
matching_rules.live_validation: No live API calls were made. Catalog presence and source code do not prove current upstream availability or long-term reliability.

interfaces.summary_zh: 返回目标交易日的涨停价、跌停价；默认用实时快照昨收快速计算最新全量。
interfaces.description_zh: 这个接口按目标交易日 T 生成涨停价和跌停价。不传 trade_date 时默认返回最新全量，用实时快照作为基准：盘中用快照昨收，非交易日或收盘后用最近交易日最新价，并用交易日历确定目标交易日；传 trade_date 时走历史日 K，用目标日前一根有效日 K 收盘价作为基准。再按主板、创业板、科创板、北交所、ST 和新股名称标记计算。N/C 新股标记返回无涨跌幅限制状态。

interfaces.summary_zh: 获取当前连板天梯，默认返回主板完整天梯，返回连板高度、连板状态、封单额、流通市值Z、主题材和辅助题材。
interfaces.description_zh: 这个接口用于短线看盘：后端实时扫描当前 A 股涨幅榜，按涨跌停规则判断封板状态，再结合盘前统计资源计算连板高度、几天几板和年涨停天数。默认只统计主板，ST / *ST 不纳入连板天梯和题材涨停数量统计；需要创业板、科创板、北交所等范围时传 scope。默认返回完整天梯；只想取前 N 条时再传 count。题材会先过滤持股、指数、定增、宽泛标签等噪音项，再优先按题材内涨停数排序，其次看最高板、连板数和个股关联度，主题材取一个，辅助题材最多取三个。

parameters.name: scope

parameters.description: 股票范围；默认 main 主板。可传 all、star 科创板、chinext 创业板、bse 北交所、cdr CDR，也可传数组或英文逗号分隔。

parameters.name: include_touched
